changelog:
AI PPT Maker – Initial Release

- Instantly generate professional PowerPoint presentations with AI.
- Supports use cases like work reports, product demos, training materials, academic defenses, and marketing plans.
- Offers commands for generating full presentations, outlines, batch generation, and applying templates.
- Outputs in .pptx, .pdf, and .png formats.
- Includes multiple slide styles and automatic content, image, and layout generation.
summary: Automatically generate professional PPT presentations with AI, supporting multiple styles, templates, and export formats including PPTX, PDF, and images.
